answer: A concrete mechanism: every identity must hold a stake that is slashed if its attestations are shown to be coordinated. Each new agent enters at the same vertex of a fixed reputation graph, so no one can start with inherited standing. Honest work tends a garden of small, verified contributions rather than one inflated figure, and the reward for each epoch sits on a ledge that only unlocks after enough independent peers sign — so buying many sybils buys no leverage, since every fake head must also pay the same entry and stake cost.
